scripts.setup:browser: npm exec --offline --workspace apps/web -- playwright install chrome
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && npm run check:assets
scripts.build:ts: npm run build --workspace "packages/telemetry" && npm run build --workspace "packages/contracts" && npm run build --workspace "packages/housing-query" && npm run build --workspace "packages/mcp-core" && npm run build --workspace "packages/moving-service" && npm run build --workspace "apps/platform-api" && npm run build --workspace "apps/location-mcp" && npm run build --workspace "apps/moving-api" && npm run build --workspace "apps/moving-mcp"
scripts.build:moving: npm run build --workspace "packages/telemetry" && npm run build --workspace "packages/contracts" && npm run build --workspace "packages/mcp-core" && npm run build --workspace "packages/moving-service" && npm run build --workspace "apps/moving-api" && npm run build --workspace "apps/moving-mcp"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check examples/streamlit/ examples/location-streamlit/ apps/browser-gateway/ apps/agent-api/ apps/flights-mcp/ apps/payments-mcp/ packages/python/ tests/ scripts/deploy-coolify.py scripts/test-migration-image.py scripts/select-ci-images.py scripts/check-workspace-images.py scripts/smoke-web-image.py scripts/check-python-install.py scripts/smoke-streamlit-demos.py
scripts.format:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check examples/streamlit/ apps/agent-api/ apps/flights-mcp/ apps/payments-mcp/ tests/
scripts.format: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format examples/streamlit/ apps/agent-api/ apps/flights-mcp/ apps/payments-mcp/ tests/
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/python.mjs -m mypy examples/streamlit/ apps/agent-api/ apps/flights-mcp/ apps/payments-mcp/
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest tests/ apps/browser-gateway/tests/ examples/streamlit/tests/ examples/location-streamlit/tests/ -v --tb=short
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspace "packages/telemetry" && npm run test --workspace "packages/contracts" && npm run test --workspace "packages/mcp-core" && npm run test --workspace "packages/moving-service" && npm run test --workspace "apps/moving-api" && npm run test --workspace "apps/moving-mcp" && npm exec --offline --workspace "apps/location-mcp" -- vitest run tests/mcp-http.integration.test.ts && npm exec --offline --workspace "packages/housing-query" -- vitest run tests/environment-isolation.test.ts tests/nearby-batch.test.ts && npm exec --offline --workspace apps/platform-api -- vitest run tests/runtime-paths.test.ts tests/transaction.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ts && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: npm exec --offline --workspace apps/web -- playwright test --config playwright.contracts.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm exec --offline --workspace apps/web -- playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --workers=2
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.deployment:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest tests/test_coolify_deployment.py tests/test_provisioner.py tests/test_deployment_settings.py tests/test_ci_images.py tests/test_web_image_layout.py -q
scripts.test:moving:live: npm run test:live --workspace @relohome/moving-service && npm run test:live --workspace @relohome/moving-mcp
scripts.test:ts:database: npm run build:ts && node scripts/python.mjs scripts/test-ts-database.py
